entities.summary: Patrick Tatopoulos (b. 1957-09-25, 12th arrondissement of Paris) was a filmmaker or theatre director of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in 12th arrondissement of Paris and France. Known in the fields of france, architects & designers, europe.
